text: Reliable information from a colleague who knows this system (it is correct): the law is a sum of 4 terms. Each term is a constant times one factor, or a constant times a product of two factors that depend on different inputs. In the forms below each c is a different unknown constant. 3 of the terms are exactly of these forms: `c*(np.log(1 + c*P))*(t)` and `c*(np.tanh(c*t))` and `c*(np.tanh(c*t))*(P**3)`.
